items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I was explaining to Nancy something the other day

ctx.x: I was explaining to Nancy something the other day, and I saw it right after that. I mean I saw a little clip of “King Tut” but the stuff we were wearing came from the Met’s production of “Aida.” And they had the thing where they had the buzzard wings spread out and crossed in the front, and that’s what they had the horn players wearing in the band. No tee shirt under it or anything you know, just this cross thing like that. It looked like an uplift bra on me.
Oh Lord. And you were playing the bass sax, weren’t you?
